relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.evidence: He completed his schooling at the Ganapathy High School in Mangalore where he obtained his S. S. L. C. in 1923.

relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.role: Intermediate degree in Arts and Science
relations.evidence: He then studied at Government College in that city completing his Intermediate degree in Arts and Science in 1925

relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.role: B. A with Honors in Mathematics
relations.evidence: going on to Presidency College, Madras  where he earned his B. A with Honors in Mathematics in 1928, a degree deemed equivalent to the M. A. in 1930.

relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies of the University of London
relations.evidence: He attended the School of Oriental and African Studies of the University of London where he received his Ph. D. in 1931

relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.evidence: Two years after receiving his doctorate, Dr. Katre was appointed Professor of Sanskrit at Wadia College in Poona.

relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.evidence: Subsequently he served as Professor of Sanskrit at Sir Parashuram College in Poona from 1937-39

relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.evidence: before being appointed in 1939 as Professor of Indo-European Philology at the Deccan College, an institution with which he would remain deeply involved until his retirement in 1971.

relations.subject: Sumitra Mangesh Katre
relations.evidence: he served as its Director from 1942-1971
